assistance_posture_summary_note: Reviewed routes distinguish mutation-tolerant text from exact committed-text fields rather than inheriting one browser/device writing-assistance posture everywhere.
autocapitalize_posture_note: Capitalization assistance is reviewed per field class and is not assumed to behave uniformly across all browsers or input methods.
autocorrect_posture_note: Autocorrection is disabled or bounded on decisive exact-string fields and reviewed cautiously on names or other record-matching text.
contact_target_mutation_boundary_note: Email-like or code-like contact fields are reviewed so the visible value is the value actually used by the route.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews which fields may tolerate browser/device writing assistance and which must preserve exact committed text before an official lookup or submit occurs.
exact_string_mutation_boundary_note: Exact identifiers and verification codes preserve committed text and do not quietly inherit helpful writing-assistance behavior.
ime_composition_commit_note: Validation and submit posture treat IME composition as provisional until committed text is available.
name_and_place_text_preservation_note: Name-like fields preserve punctuation, spacing, and reviewable committed text rather than treating browser/device corrections as the office's required spelling.
premature_validation_or_submit_note: Auto-advance, lookup, and submit behavior are reviewed so provisional composition or mutated text is not treated as final by accident.

reviewed_field_classes.class_note: Freeform help text may tolerate capitalization or spelling assistance when the office is comfortable with that posture.
Names are reviewed cautiously so punctuation, spacing, diacritics, and committed casing are not silently rewritten without review.
Identifiers, tracking tokens, and codes are reviewed as exact committed text rather than as mutation-friendly prose.

same_answer_across_assistance_variants_n: The authoritative answer/help lane does not materially drift across supported writing-assistance variants, pasted input, or composition-driven entry paths.
sensitive_field_spellcheck_boundary_note: Sensitive lookup tokens and similar values are reviewed for whether spellcheck should remain off to avoid silent mutation or external handling surprises.
spellcheck_posture_note: Spellcheck is reviewed field by field rather than left enabled by accident on every editable control.
text_assistance_surface_label: Example text-assistance posture for official voter-information routes
visible_review_and_correction_note: The voter can review and correct the value that will actually drive lookup or submit before the route commits decisive action.
